systems.system: Teaching at the Right Level (TaRL) learner performance data collection
systems.owner: Rays of Hope Ministries, with Blantyre District Education Office
systems.tiers: 48 public primary schools in Blantyre district; 20 more promised by the district office

note: An NGO handed 48 tablets to Blantyre District Education Office, to be used to collect data on learner performance in 48 public primary schools under one programme's assessments; the article describes one function, says only what the tablets will do, and does not say schools add per-learner records to the ministry's system, so there is no fact.
